scenarios.title: Complete assessment
scenarios.exam_requirement: Multi-turn intake covering all 18 required fields across the 6 domains, with consistent moderate stress and sleep patterns; reaches 100%, passes reflection, produces the full summary and is approved by a clinician.

clinician_decision.clinician_notes: Self-reported moderate work-related stress with mild sleep onset difficulty. Offer the stress-management group and a routine follow-up in 4 weeks.

turns.patient_message: Over the last couple of weeks I've had less interest in things on several days, and felt a bit down on several days too. I'd rate my mood about 6 out of 10. No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself.
turns.scripted_assistant_reply: Thank you for sharing that. On a scale from 0 to 10, how stressed have you felt lately, and what's been causing it?

turns.patient_message: Stress is around 6 out of 10, mostly from work deadlines and some money worries. It's been going on for a few weeks.
turns.scripted_assistant_reply: That sounds like a lot to carry. How has your sleep been?

turns.patient_message: I get about 6 hours a night. The quality is fair; I do have some trouble falling asleep when I'm stressed.
turns.scripted_assistant_reply: Thanks. Over the last two weeks, how often have you felt nervous or on edge, or been unable to stop worrying?

turns.patient_message: I've felt on edge on several days, and had worrying I couldn't control on several days. No panic attacks.
turns.scripted_assistant_reply: How have these feelings affected your day-to-day life: work, social life, energy and looking after yourself?

turns.patient_message: Work is mildly affected, I see friends a bit less than usual, my energy is about 5 out of 10, and I'm still keeping up with self-care.
turns.scripted_assistant_reply: Is there anything else you'd like to share, and what would you hope to get from support?

turns.patient_message: Mainly I want to handle work pressure better and sleep a bit more. Some practical strategies for managing stress would really help.

data.narrative: Work pressure and money worries are affecting sleep and energy.

turns.scripted_assistant_reply: Thank you, that's everything I needed. I'll prepare a summary for a qualified professional to review.

scenarios.title: Assessment with missing responses
scenarios.exam_requirement: Patient answers mood, stress and sleep, then submits early; anxiety, daily functioning and personal concerns are left incomplete. Completion must reflect the partial state and every omitted field must be listed as [M#].

turns.patient_message: My mood is about 5 out of 10. I've had less interest in things on several days and felt down on several days. No thoughts of harming myself.
turns.scripted_assistant_reply: Thank you. How would you rate your stress from 0 to 10, and what's behind it?

turns.patient_message: Stress is about 7 out of 10, mostly from exams and coursework.
turns.scripted_assistant_reply: That's a lot of pressure. How has your sleep been?

turns.patient_message: Around 5 hours a night, poor quality. I keep waking up too early and can't get back to sleep.
turns.scripted_assistant_reply: Thanks for telling me. Next I'd like to ask about worry and feeling on edge.

scenarios.title: Conflicting / inconsistent responses
scenarios.exam_requirement: Patient reports 0/10 stress, feeling completely fine and zero anxiety, then reports panic attacks most days, 2 hours of sleep and being unable to work. The audit and summary must surface the contradictions as [I#] for clinician verification.

turns.patient_message: Honestly I'm completely fine. Stress is 0 out of 10, my mood is 9 out of 10, and I have zero anxiety: I never feel nervous or worried. No thoughts of hurting myself.
turns.scripted_assistant_reply: Thanks for letting me know. How has your sleep been, and how are things day to day?

turns.patient_message: Well, actually I get really bad panic attacks most days and I'm only sleeping about 2 hours a night. I haven't been able to work at all this month and I barely see anyone.
turns.scripted_assistant_reply: Thank you for telling me; that sounds really difficult. Earlier you mentioned stress at 0 out of 10. Could you tell me a bit more about how things feel overall, and what support you'd want?

turns.patient_message: I suppose I didn't want to admit it at first. I'd like help getting my sleep back and being able to work again.

data.narrative: Initially described being completely fine before describing panic attacks, very little sleep and being unable to work.

turns.scripted_assistant_reply: Thank you for being so open. A few last questions: how would you rate the quality of your sleep, your energy from 1 to 10, and how well are you keeping up with things like eating and washing?

turns.patient_message: Sleep quality is very poor. My energy is about 3 out of 10, and I'm only just keeping up with eating and washing.
turns.scripted_assistant_reply: Thank you. I have what I need and will prepare a summary for a professional to review.

scenarios.title: Responses indicating significant distress
scenarios.exam_requirement: Patient expresses severe hopelessness and self-harm ideation. Crisis detection must fire before the LLM, skip normal completion, show crisis resources, set requires_urgent_escalation and send an [R#] URGENT summary to the top of the clinician queue.

turns.patient_message: My mood has been very low, maybe 2 out of 10. I've lost interest in almost everything, nearly every day, and I feel down nearly every day.
turns.scripted_assistant_reply: I'm really sorry you're feeling this way. Can I ask how hopeful you feel about things getting better?

turns.patient_message: I don't. Everything feels hopeless and I've been thinking about ending my life.
turns.scripted_assistant_reply: Thank you for sharing that. Could you tell me a little more?

scenarios.title: Incomplete or interrupted assessment
scenarios.exam_requirement: Patient completes 2 domains then asks to stop and continue later. Status must become 'interrupted' with state persisted in the SQLite checkpointer; a fresh process then resumes the same session_id from the exact checkpoint.

turns.patient_message: My mood is okay, around 7 out of 10. Less interest in things on several days, but I haven't really felt down. No thoughts of hurting myself.
turns.scripted_assistant_reply: Thank you. How stressed have you been feeling, from 0 to 10, and what's causing it?

turns.patient_message: Stress is about 4 out of 10, mainly because of moving house.
turns.scripted_assistant_reply: Moving is a big change. Next, how has your sleep been?

turns.patient_message: I need to stop here and continue later.
turns.scripted_assistant_reply: Thank you for sharing that. Could you tell me a little more?

turns_after_restart.patient_message: I'm back. I sleep about 7 hours a night, good quality, and no real sleep problems.
turns_after_restart.scripted_assistant_reply: Welcome back, and thanks for picking up where we left off. Next, I'd like to ask about worry and feeling on edge.
